description_en: Creates a resource group for a specified Dedicated Edition, Basic Edition, or Data Lakehouse Edition cluster
description_zh: 为指定的企业版、基础版或湖仓版集群创建资源组
kebab_example: aliyun adb create-db-resource-group --db-cluster-id amv-bp11q28kvl6880000 --group-name test_group --group-type Job --min-compute-resource 0ACU --max-compute-resource 48ACU --cluster-size-resource - --min-cluster-count 1 --max-cluster-count 1 --cluster-mode - --enable-spot true --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --rules GroupName=test_group QueryTime=180000 TargetGroupName=job --engine SparkWarehouse --engine-params spark.adb.version_:_3.5 --auto-stop-interval 5m --spec-name ADB.MLLarge.2 --min-gpu-quantity 1 --max-gpu-quantity 2 --target-resource-group-name test --ray-config '{"EnableUserEni":true,"UserDefinedRequirements":"example-string","HeadSpec":"xlarge","HeadDiskCapacity":"100G","Category":"BASIC","HeadSpecType":"CPU","WorkerGroups":[{"GroupName":"test","MinWorkerQuantity":1,"MaxWorkerQuantity":2,"WorkerSpecName":"xlarge","WorkerDiskCapacity":"100G","WorkerSpecType":"GPU","AllocateUnit":"1"}],"HeadAllocateUnit":"1"}' --gpu-elastic-plan '{"Enabled":true,"Rules":[{"EndCronExpression":"0_0_3_0_0_0","StartCronExpression":"0_0_2_0_0_0"}]}' --scale-policy AutoScaling --classification SQL --atm-config SelectNodeSpec=8ACU StorageNodeNum=2 StorageNodeDiskType=essd_pl1 InsertNodeSpec=8ACU InsertNodeNum=2 AuthNodeNum=2 StorageNodeSpec=8ACU SelectNodeCacheSize=10 AuthNodeSpec=8ACU SelectNodeNum=1 StorageNodeDiskSize=1 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDBResourceGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Dedicated Edition, Basic Edition, or Data Lakehouse Edition cluster
parameters.help_zh: 企业版、基础版或湖仓版集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the resource group.
- The name can be up to 255 characters in length.
- The name must start with a digit, an uppercase letter, or a lowercase letter.
- The name can contain digits, uppercase letters, lowercase letters, hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh:
资源组名称。
- 长度不超过255个字符。
- 必须以数字、大写字母或小写字母开头。
- 可包含数字、大写字母、小写字母、中划线（-）和下划线（_）
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource group. Valid values:
- **Interactive**
- **Job**
> For more information about Data Lakehouse Edition resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428610.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源组类型，取值：
- **Interactive**
- **Job**
> 关于湖仓版资源组的详细信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428610.html
parameters.name: group_type

parameters.help_en:
The minimum amount of reserved computing resources. Unit: ACUs.
- If the resource group type is Interactive, the minimum reserved computing resources is 16 ACUs.
- If the resource group type is Job, the minimum reserved computing resources is 0 ACUs
parameters.help_zh:
最小计算预留资源，单位为ACU。
- 当资源组类型为Interactive时，计算预留资源最小为16 ACU。
- 当资源组类型为Job时，计算预留资源最小为0 ACU
parameters.name: min_compute_resource

parameters.help_en:
The maximum amount of reserved computing resources. Unit: ACUs.
- If the resource group type is Interactive, the maximum reserved computing resources is the current unallocated resources of the cluster, in increments of 16 ACUs.
- If the resource group type is Job, the maximum reserved computing resources is the current unallocated resources of the cluster, in increments of 8 ACUs
parameters.help_zh:
最大计算预留资源，单位为ACU。
- 当资源组类型为Interactive时，计算预留资源最大为集群当前未分配资源，步长为16 ACU。
- 当资源组类型为Job时，计算预留资源最大为集群当前未分配资源，步长为8 ACU
parameters.name: max_compute_resource

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter (not applicable)
parameters.help_zh: 预留参数（不涉及）
parameters.name: cluster_size_resource

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter (not applicable)
parameters.help_zh: 预留参数（不涉及）
parameters.name: min_cluster_count

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter (not applicable)
parameters.help_zh: 预留参数（不涉及）
parameters.name: max_cluster_count

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter (not applicable)
parameters.help_zh: 预留参数（不涉及）
parameters.name: cluster_mode

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the spot instance feature for the resource group. After the spot instance feature is enabled, the unit price of resources is reduced, but the resources may be released. Only Job resource groups support this feature. Valid values:
- **True**: enables the spot instance feature.
- **False**: disables the spot instance feature
parameters.help_zh:
资源组是否开启竞价实例功能。开启竞价实例后资源单价降低，但是有概率被释放。仅Job型资源组可以开启。取值：
- **True**：开启竞价实例功能。
- **False**：关闭竞价实例功能
parameters.name: enable_spot

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612393.html operation to query the region IDs of AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition (V3.0) clusters
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612393.html接口查看AnalyticDB MySQL湖仓版（3.0）集群的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
